name: Aident Loadout
description: Remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, OAuth) that connects Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients to 1,000+ apps and 400+ expert-built Skills through one setup. Credentials stay in Aident Vault; every action is logged in Audit. Homepage: https://aident.ai — MCP endpoint: https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp

installation.command: claude mcp add --transport http aident https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp

examples: Add remote MCP: claude mcp add --transport http aident https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp
Connect Cursor / ChatGPT / Codex to https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp (streamable HTTP + OAuth)

requirements.other: MCP client with streamable HTTP + OAuth support; Aident account at https://aident.ai

features: Remote MCP over streamable HTTP with OAuth
1,000+ apps and 400+ expert-built Skills in one setup
Works with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients
